options.tooltip: Activates the new advanced stealth mechanics, which allows you to hide from zombies behind cars, takes traits and weather into account, and much more.

options.label: Environmental Attacks
options.tooltip: If zombies that have not seen/heard player can attack doors and constructions while roaming.

options.label: Damage Construction
options.tooltip: If zombies can destroy player constructions and defenses.

options.label: Day/Night Zombie Speed Effect
options.tooltip:
Whether zombies are more "active" during the day or night. 
"Active" zombies will use the speed set in the "Speed" setting. 
"Inactive" zombies will be slower, and tend not to give chase.
Default = Both

options.label: Zombie House Alarm Triggering
options.tooltip: If zombies trigger house alarms when breaking through windows or doors.

options.label: Drag Down
options.tooltip: If multiple attacking zombies can drag you down and kill you. \nDependent on zombie strength.

options.label: Crawlers Drag Down
options.tooltip: If crawler zombies beside a player contribute to the chance of being dragged down and killed by a group of zombies.

options.label: Zombie Lunge
options.tooltip: If zombies have a chance to lunge at you after climbing\nover a fence or through a window if you're too close.

options.label: Zombie Armor Factor
options.tooltip: Serves as a multiplier when determining the effectiveness of armor worn by zombies.\nMin: 0.00 Max: 100.00 Default: 2.00

options.label: Maximum Zombie Armor Defense
options.tooltip: The maximum defense percentage that any worn protective garments can provide to a zombie.\nMin: 0 Max: 100 Default: 85

options.label: Chance Of Attached Weapon
options.tooltip: Percentage chance of having a random attached weapon.\nMin: 0 Max: 100 Default: 6

options.label: Zombie Fall Damage Multiplier
options.tooltip: How much damage zombies take when falling from height.\nMin: 0.00 Max: 100.00 Default: 1.00

options.label: Fake Dead Zombie Reanimation
options.tooltip: Whether some dead-looking zombies will reanimate and attack the player.\nDefault = World Zombies

options.label: Player Spawn Area
options.tooltip: Zombies will not spawn where players spawn.\nDefault = Inside the building and around it
enum: Inside the building and around it

options.label: Zombies To Damage Fences
options.tooltip: How many zombies it takes to damage a tall fence.\nMin: -1 Max: 100 Default: 25

options.label: Fence Damage Multiplier
options.tooltip: How quickly zombies damage tall fences.\nMin: 0.01 Max: 100.00 Default: 1.00

options.label: Population Multiplier
options.tooltip: Set by the "Zombie Count" population option, or by a custom number here.\nInsane = 2.5, Very High = 1.6, High = 1.2, Normal = 0.65, Low = 0.15, None = 0.0.\nMin: 0.00 Max: 4.00 Default: 0.65

options.label: Population Start Multiplier
options.tooltip: A multiplier for the desired zombie population at the start of the game.\nInsane = 3.0, Very High = 2.0, High = 1.5, Normal = 1.0, Low = 0.5, None = 0.0.\nMin: 0.00 Max: 4.00 Default: 1.00

options.label: Population Peak Multiplier
options.tooltip: A multiplier for the desired zombie population on the peak day.\nInsane = 3.0, Very High = 2.0, High = 1.5, Normal = 1.0, Low = 0.5, None = 0.0.\nMin: 0.00 Max: 4.00 Default: 1.50

options.label: Population Peak Day
options.tooltip: The day when the population reaches its peak.\nMin: 1 Max: 365 Default: 28

options.label: Respawn Hours
options.tooltip: The number of hours that must pass before zombies may respawn in a cell.\nIf 0, spawning is disabled.\nMin: 0.00 Max: 8760.00 Default: 0.00

options.label: Respawn Unseen Hours
options.tooltip: The number of hours that a chunk must be unseen before zombies may respawn in it.\nMin: 0.00 Max: 8760.00 Default: 0.00

options.label: Respawn Multiplier
options.tooltip: The fraction of a cell's desired population that may respawn every RespawnHours.\nMin: 0.00 Max: 1.00 Default: 0.00

options.label: Redistribute Hours
options.tooltip:
The number of hours that must pass before zombies migrate
 to empty parts of the same cell.
If 0, migration is disabled.
Min: 0.00 Max: 8760.00 Default: 12.00

options.label: Follow Sound Distance
options.tooltip: The distance a zombie will try to walk towards the last sound it heard.\nMin: 10 Max: 1000 Default: 100

options.label: Rally Group Size
options.tooltip: The size of groups real zombies form when idle. 0 means zombies don't form groups.\nGroups don't form inside buildings or forest zones.\nMin: 0 Max: 1000 Default: 20

options.label: Rally Group Size Variance
options.tooltip: The amount, as a percentage, that zombie groups can vary in size from the default (both larger and smaller). \n For example, at 50% variance with a default group size of 20, groups will vary in size from 10-30.\nMin: 0 Max: 100 Default: 50

options.label: Rally Travel Distance
options.tooltip: The distance real zombies travel to form groups when idle.\nMin: 5 Max: 50 Default: 20

options.label: Rally Group Separation
options.tooltip: The distance between zombie groups.\nMin: 5 Max: 25 Default: 15

options.label: Rally Group Radius
options.tooltip: How close members of a zombie group stay to the group's "leader".\nMin: 1 Max: 10 Default: 3

options.label: Zombie count before deletion
options.tooltip:
Controls the maximum number of zombies tracked before cleanup occurs. 0 means zombies will not be cleaned up.
The default value (300) is strongly recommended. Increasing this value or setting to 0 may cause severe performance problems.
For troubleshooting and bug-report purposes, please reproduce any issue with the default setting before submitting a report.
Min: 0 Max: 5000 Default: 300
